scope.changed_factor: Actual rejected-trial competitor keys share the original 16 alternative slots. V7 risk and current-slack safety prefix, original floors, 64/512 gradient caps, solver, alphas and acceptance guards unchanged.

comparison.note: These reused optimization TRAIN anchors establish neither independent recognition accuracy nor human semantic boundaries. V10 is not adopted. V7 remains a research comparison champion, not a release.

microscope.occurrence_limit: Repeated actual guard-loss occurrences across deliberately rejected trials; not unique cases or recognition error rates. The observed pool excludes currently unsafe ranks and pair conditions already below the original floor.
microscope.interpretation: Most admitted witnesses were additional current-primary safety conditions, not new nonadjacent competitors. They consumed slots previously assigned to nearby weak rivals; the observed first-round displacement and later exact-selected nonlinear failures contradict the hypothesis that forgotten nonadjacent competitors alone explain the bottleneck. This is not a global impossibility proof.

next_bounded_hypothesis.experiment: Return to unchanged v7 selection and original parent. Detach the encoder embedding only for gradient computation, so just the two linear-head parameter tensors can change. With fixed embeddings, each fixed-rival logit margin is affine in head parameters, separating nonlinear encoder-update error from missing constraints.
next_bounded_hypothesis.verification_required: All 55 non-head tensors bit-exact to original parent; head-only nonzero gradients; same original floors, guards, 64/512 direction caps and real full logits; fixed-rival prediction residuals reported independently; batch1/16/32 parity. No claim that linear-head capacity suffices until experiment passes.
